claims.author: kevkevinpal
claims.quote: `test_mined_block_stats_cleared_on_failed_mempool_load` checks the cleared window only in memory.
claims.request: Test that the cleared window is written to disk across a node restart after failed mempool load

status_by.quote: Once the window is empty in memory, any subsequent flush necessarily writes an empty window. So asserting the in-memory state after the failed load is sufficient; a disk round-trip is redundant.

claims.status_note: author explained that FlushMinedBlockStats flushes the cleared vector so in-memory verification is sufficient
